events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Liam Gallagher, known as the frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, was born on this day in Manchester in 1972.

angles.name: Still Rockin' It
angles.copy: The iconic voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher, celebrates turning 54 today. What's your favourite track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album is 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic second solo album, 'Imagine', was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine the Impact
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released his seminal album 'Imagine'. A timeless message that still resonates today. What does the album mean to you?

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Click Wheel Memories
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. What was on your first iPod playlist?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, which Bond film or song is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder, singer, and peace activist John Lennon was born on this day in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: A Legacy of Peace & Music
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, a founding member of Monty Python, was born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment from the comedy legend?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' is 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: An Iconic Double
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. What are your essential tracks from this legendary record?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Queen frontman and music icon Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Forever a Champion
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy are truly unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' is 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A Shift in Sound
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' marked a pivotal moment in their career. What's your favourite track from this influential album?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Musician and peace activist John Lennon was tragically killed on this day in New York City in 1980.

angles.name: Gone But Never Forgotten
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon. His indelible mark on music and his message of peace continue to resonate globally.
